today.label: Today at Sacred Ground
today.notes: Every morning 9:00 AM America/Chicago (settings schedule_local_time=09:00; Cursor Automation must also be 9:00 AM CT — agents cannot edit Automations). Lineup = ALL remaining events on publish day (full day, not evening-only) + ALL events on tomorrow. Caption opener is today-first when today has events; tomorrow-only wording only when today is empty. Flyer prefers today’s date key when today has events, else tomorrow. On-image word TODAY / TOMORROW matches flyer day; prebranded flyers skip overlays. Campaign key stays 'today' for publish-today. Never lead with “tonight” at 9am when daytime sessions exist. Do NOT flip to 10:00 unless Founder explicitly wants 10am.

week_ahead.label: Next 2 Days at Sacred Ground
week_ahead.notes: Every evening 8pm CT: next 2 days starting tomorrow only (Sat 8pm → Sun+Mon). Do NOT include the publish day's events (morning through night / same-day evening). Morning + afternoon own tonight. Observatory + Library night block. Night creative pool — no morning specialty art.

afternoon_spotlight.label: Afternoon Spotlight
afternoon_spotlight.notes: Daily 5:00 PM CT (Meta Insights: Lions Gate–style ~5pm promo had strong early traction; leaves a clear gap before 8pm week_ahead). Flip schedule_local_time to 16:00 for 4pm. Single-event spotlight — not a full calendar dump. Prefer tonight's best remaining evening event; else tomorrow's standout; else warm brand/visit. Image: prefer an UNUSED event_featured / TEC thumbnail / Founder-provided flyer — NEVER reuse any previously posted URL including morning celestial, morning_flyer, or today's Eve flyer tomorrow (Founder 2026-08-12 FINAL lifetime never-reuse). When the TEC thumb was already posted, regenerate new afternoon art (designed-in shop pride required). Avoids stacking a third full calendar with morning-tomorrow + week_ahead.

tuesday_meditation.label: Tuesday Free Community Meditation
tuesday_meditation.notes: Every Tuesday 4:00 PM America/Chicago: dedicated Free Community Meditation FB+IG post. Skip only Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Eve, New Year's Day (Chicago local date). Image rotates Om / silhouette / metaphysical journey / sg-morning-meditation with 7-day no-repeat.

daily_reel.label: Daily AI-Deneene Reel (IG + FB Reels)
daily_reel.notes: Scaffold only. Target: daily Instagram Reels + Facebook Reels at 10:30 AM America/Chicago. Image FB/IG via Zernio works today; video path needs HeyGen generate + hosted MP4 URL + Zernio/ML Social (or Meta) Reels support. Do not enable or auto_publish until video publish is verified. Does not touch today/week_ahead/tuesday_meditation.

tuesday_community_meditation.notes: Standing Tuesday 7–8pm Free Community Meditation — always include in Today + week-ahead when that Tuesday is in scope. Inject stub only if TEC feed omitted it. HARD RULE (Founder 2026-08-09): never name who leads meditation in public captions — anonymous block only (session_display + doors_close_display). config/meditation_hosts.json is ops/internal only. Strip facilitator names from TEC titles in captions. HARD RULE (Founder 2026-08-31): session is ALWAYS 7:00–8:00 PM America/Chicago — never 7–9. classify.enrich + format_when clamp TEC end times; afternoon_spotlight must not publish a 2-hour window.
